desktopDOM.description:
The Iowa satellite map presents the state as a continuous landscape image, with the patchwork of fields and river corridors providing its visual texture. The state outline is emphasized against the surrounding imagery, giving the composition a clear geographic focus.

The image is suited to map-led editorial layouts, presentations about Iowa and regional display graphics. It can form the central image of a printed map or provide geographic context within a wider design.

FAQ
Can I use this map in GIS programs?

This map is not geo-referenced, but feel free to contact us to obtain a file with geo data if needed.
